findings.message: 1 line in "Up to 5 back blows" has no quote from the guideline ("The guideline does not say how an adult should be positio…"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
1 line in "Up to 5 chest thrusts" has no quote from the guideline ("This guideline does not describe where the CPR compressio…"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
2 lines in "They are unresponsive" have no quote from the guideline ("Make sure an ambulance has been called."). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
2 lines in "It has cleared" have no quote from the guideline ("Well done. The blockage has cleared."). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
1 line in "The ambulance has arrived" has no quote from the guideline ("Tell the ambulance staff what happened and what you have …"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
Nobody is named under "Reviewed by:", so the app shows "Not reviewed".
The saved guideline text is a web copy made by a fetch tool and may not be word-perfect, so a "quote not found" may be the copy's fault. Add the PDF to sources/ for exact checking.
